//setup: Ships false so a fresh install opens the first-run Setup wizard. Set true (with a scaleId) once configured; the wizard does this on Finish.
//db: Live SQL Server (integrated security, via .NET SqlClient â€” no driver). The app reads/writes this database like the legacy software.
//edge: Weight indicator. connection: 'serial' | 'tcp'. Values below were verified live on this PC.

serial.//port: COM5 = Prolific USB-to-Serial (the weighbridge indicator on this PC). Fallback: COM1.

edge.//parse: Verified live on COM5 @ 2400: each frame is STX + 6 ASCII digits + ETX + CR + LF (10 bytes). e.g. <STX>000220<ETX> => 220 kg. startHex '02' anchors framing on STX.

//cameras: IP cameras (from the live Camera table). RTSPMJPEG â€” a frame is grabbed from the RTSP sub-stream via bundled ffmpeg, exactly like the legacy VLC snapshot. One entry per physical camera.
//sync: Legacy JSON-outbox/HTTP sync — superseded by vpsSql (SQL-to-SQL). Disabled.
//vpsSql: Central server both bridges push to (SQL-to-SQL over an SSH tunnel). The Setup wizard fills these in per PC. Password left blank in the template — enter it at setup.

storage.//: Set at runtime to %APPDATA%/WeighCore if left blank.
